title: Juicy Flavorful Mediterranean Beef Stew
description: A comforting, floral, cheese-pull Mediterranean dish featuring beef, tomatoes, and a lacquer-glaze. Ideal for anti-inflammatory diets.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the beef until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove the beef from the pot and set it aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the beef back to the pot along with the diced tomatoes, beef broth, and dried thyme.
Bring the stew to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the oven to cook at 300°F (150°C) for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and stir in the honey and lemon juice to create the lacquer-glaze.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste, then serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley.
Let the stew rest for 10 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld and the cheese to pull.
